Your clinical massage biz mentor.

Hi – I’m Sam Visnic.
Owner of Release Muscle Therapy in Temecula, CA.

I help solo massage therapists rapidly build a practice with easy-to-implement digital marketing and automation systems.

Being an independent therapist is about FREEDOM.
To control your schedule.
To control your fees and your finances. 
To be able to help the people you want to help.
And get compensated fairly for your skills. 

Together we can make this a reality for you. Subscribe to the channel for free how-to videos, inspiration, and tutorials.
